text:
Elaine: Quick thread to lock landing copy + promo plan for next week's launch. Focus: Hosted API, Dedicated, Private pages + promo posts + webinar. Can we bullet final asks?

Diego: Main asks: 1) tight hero lines for each mode (one-liners), 2) social benchmark angle + visual, 3) registration and routing logic.

Sam: Hero drafts (short): Hosted: "Get inference live in minutes" Dedicated: "Capacity you can count on" Private: "Run inference inside your network" Keeping verbs active.

Rachel: Webinar concept: 45 min total. 20m demo (fast path hosted + Optimize tweaks), 15m ops (autoscale, batching, rollouts), 10m enterprise (security, KMS). CTA on page: register + select "I'm evaluating" vs "ready to buy".

Diego: Benchmark social copy idea: "Benchmark: 60% lower latency P95 on typical chat workloads with Redwood Optimize + batching. See the chart in the webinar." Visual: bar chart (P95) + cost/token callout.

Sam: For CTAs on landing: Primary: Register (webinar). Secondary: Compare modes (matrix). Tertiary: Contact sales (Private interest).

Elaine: Routing plan: keep separate forms but one modal on the landing. Hidden fields: utm_source, utm_campaign, utm_content, variant_id. Map utm_content to list tags: hosted_tag / dedicated_tag / private_tag. HubSpot lists: HS-Hosted, HS-Dedicated, HS-Private.

Rachel: Form fields (minimal): name, email, company, role, use-case (checkbox: chat, embeddings, search), deployment interest (radio). Add a short privacy line on Private option: "Your info is for enterprise follow-up only." (Rachel to confirm with Legal).

Diego: Automation: Zapier workflow -> tag leads by utm_content -> if private_tag then route to Solutions Eng queue, if dedicated_tag then AE assignment, else SDR nurture. Also capture source_page + variant for AB analysis.

Sam: Social post cadence: Teaser post (benchmark gif) 3 days before, webinar promo 2 days before, reminder day-of. Use 2 alt headlines for A/B: 1) "Ship reliable LLM features faster" 2) "Cut inference cost and maintain latency SLOs"

Elaine: Copy tone: practical, measurable. Avoid hype words. Include a single testimonial slice on the landing: short quote + logo. Sam to get quote from benchmarks owner.

Rachel: Compare page decision: public matrix with feature checkmarks; gating only for compliance docs (Private checklist PDF behind form). Good?

Diego: Agreed. Add CTA on matrix: "See enterprise checklist" -> gated form route.

eng-bot: Reminder: marketing assets deadline in 36h. Upload final hero images + chart assets to /launch/assets (placeholder).

Sam: I'll attach the benchmark CSV and the sample chart. Diego will wire the UTMs into the social scheduler.

Elaine: Owners: Sam (benchmarks + visuals), Diego (forms & routing), Rachel (webinar flow + legal privacy check). I'll do a final pass on landing microcopy tonight.

Diego: One more: email subject options for registrants? Suggest: "Live demo: inference at production scale" or "See how teams cut inference cost + latency". Pick one for send.

Rachel: Prefer the second for CTR. Short preheader: "Live demo + benchmark breakdown."

Elaine: Great. Closing notes uploaded to the launch checklist. Will reopen if any blockers. :rocket:

(End of thread)
